Haan, dil ek organ hai; dil, blood vessels aur blood milkar circulatory system mein kaam karte hain. Aapki football team wali comparison farq dikhati hai. Ab plant mein patta aur xylem ko levels mein kahan rakhenge?
Patta... patta organ hai. Red blood cell... cell. Dil organ hai? Haan, organ. Xylem... xylem tissue hai. Aur nervous system, woh organ system. Sahi hai na?

Haan, aapne paanchon sahi baante: patta aur dil organ, red blood cell cell, xylem tissue, aur nervous system organ system. Ab ek naya case: amoeba ek hi cell hai, phir bhi khaata aur chalta hai. Kya usmein tissues ya organs hote hain, aur woh yeh kaam kaise karta hai?

Amoeba mein tissues nahi hote... kyunki woh ek cell hai. Toh woh kaise khaata hai... woh apna mouth use karta hai? Aur chalne ke liye legs? Par uske legs nahi hain... I don't know, ma'am. Shayad uske andar chhote organs hote hain jo hum dekh nahi sakte?

Ek cell hone ki wajah se amoeba mein tissues nahi hote. Uske chhote organs bhi nahi hote: wahi ek cell apna aakaar badalkar pair jaise ubhaar banata hai, jinse woh chalta aur khaana gher leta hai. Ab organ ke theek baad kaunsa level aata hai?
